These are native Palace v0.14.0 scattering columns from `renderBoard()` in
`tests/fixtures/render-board.tsx`, using the same explicit pad-port setup as
`air-domain-validation.test.tsx`. The JSON is generated by the TSX control; it
is not an AM3352 result. Frequency is 100 MHz, 400 MHz, 1 GHz, 2 GHz and 5 GHz.
The field mesh uses PEC copper cavities and the fixture's dielectric losses.

Both MPI runs completed on two processes. Maximum reciprocity error is
1.12e-7 and the maximum singular value is 0.9999833. This is an integration
control, not mesh convergence or routing signoff. The reader corruption tests
retain these raw columns rather than fitting or enforcing passivity.
